text: The key difference is shape and color together with their printed labels: item A is a solid red circle labeled **"A17,"** while item B is a solid blue square labeled **"B28,"** so the form (curved versus straight-edged) and the text beneath it change together and are never interchangeable — though neither the colors nor the labels tell us any intended meaning.
